content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education Organisational units Central Offices International Office International Office The International Office coordinates the international programmes of HTW Berlin and offers a wide range of services in the area of internationalisation, including basic issues relating to partnership and cooperation agreements, representing the interests of HTW Berlin in Germany and abroad, and implementing mobility programmes.
